targets.rawSql: SELECT event_type, count(*) AS total_events FROM event_raw WHERE ('$page_url' = '*' OR page_url = '$page_url') GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY total_events DESC;
SELECT page_url, grid_x, grid_y, event_count, updated_at FROM mouse_heatmap WHERE ('$page_url' = '*' OR page_url = '$page_url') ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 50;
SELECT grid_x, grid_y, SUM(event_count) AS event_count FROM mouse_heatmap WHERE ('$page_url' = '*' OR page_url = '$page_url') GROUP BY grid_x, grid_y ORDER BY grid_y, grid_x;
